description: FHWA-DANATool provides FHWA's DANA tool for assembling traffic inputs to MOVES emissions analysis and TNMAide noise analysis. The provider is US DOT Volpe and FHWA. Geographical and temporal coverage: The tool compiles measured traffic conditions for environmental assessments in the United States. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): MIT. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: This prepares model inputs; it does not itself replace the emissions and noise models. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
